title: A Gap with a Deficit of Large Grains in the Protoplanetary Disk around TW Hya
question: What is the dust continuum structure (gaps, rings) and the radial profile of spectral index and dust opacity index beta in the TW Hya disk at ~3 au resolution, and what do they imply for the gap origin?

what.value: Band 7 high-resolution (~1 au) ALMA results used for comparison

evidence.quote: These observed features agree with those found by recent high-resolution ($\sim$1 au) observations at band 7 (cite: bib:andrews2016).
We have combined band 6 archival data (2012.1.00422.S)

what.value: Dust mass opacity theory for interpreting small beta

evidence.quote: according to the theoretical calculation of dust mass opacity (cite: bib:draine2006)

recipe.method: CASA calibration; combine archival B6 short baselines with new B6 after phase shift; flag B6 uv>3000 klambda
Iterative self-calibration using the initial CLEAN image as model; multiscale CLEAN with Briggs weighting

recipe.goal: Make combined MFS image and alpha map
recipe.method: MFS imaging of all self-calibrated data at 190 GHz, robust=0, scales 0,60,180 mas

recipe.goal: Derive deprojected radial profiles of brightness temperature and alpha
recipe.method: Deprojected azimuthal averaging; flux converted to Tb with Planck function; errors from azimuthal standard deviation
Solve I_nu = B_nu(Td)(1-exp(-tau)) and alpha equation with tau_nu ∝ nu^beta given assumed Td(R)
Kanagawa et al. gap shape-planet mass relation

evidence.quote: There are two prominent gaps at 22 and 37 au, and relatively weak decrements are also seen at 6, 28, and 44 au.

answer_key.quantity: 22 au gap FWHM and relative depth

evidence.quote: The full width at half maximum and the relative depth are roughly 7 au and 50 % for the 22 au gap
The total flux densities are 152.0$\pm$0.3 and 558.3$\pm$0.7 Jy for band 4 and 6, respectively.
